verdict.rationale: Adyen documents first-party, Adyen-generated reports intended for bookkeeping and reconciliation of funds within the platform, so the core capability exists. The pack gives only one thin mention: nothing describes per-seller versus rolled-up granularity, report types or formats, or how reports are delivered or scheduled. The generic webhooks evidence is not about report delivery and is not credited. Missing for 10: per-seller and platform-level rollup report evidence, file or API delivery mechanism for reports, scheduled/automated report generation, documented report formats, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, reconciliation is automatable — settlement and balance reports per seller and rolled up, delivered as files or APIs my finance stack consumes on schedule

citations.quote: use Adyen-generated reports for your bookkeeping and reconciliation processes to ensure accurate accounting of funds within your platform
